title: Check legacy Windows task ownership before updates even after a saved service opt-out.
changes: Check for a surviving legacy Scheduled Task independently of serviceInstalled:false before changing npm packages or executable shims.
Refuse updates when Task Scheduler reports an existing task, access denial or ambiguous output; preserve package state instead of attempting an unowned handover.
Keep check-only and already-current Windows updates before the package-mutation preflight, and permit manual updates after verified task absence.
Cover the opt-out path with isolated package-write and command instrumentation on Windows x64, Windows ARM64 and Linux. Legacy task migration remains separate work.
